items.name: AI Sizing & Proposal Approval Workflow
items.description: Steps to turn raw field inputs into an approved, paid job via FastAPI and Groq.
steps: Operator submits coordinates + daily water needs
FastAPI queries NASA solar database & manufacturer curves
Llama 3 sizing recommendation generated as proposal draft (PENDING_TM)
Technical Manager reviews/verifies proposal (CHECKED)
General Manager approves feasibility (GM_APPROVED)
Finance verifies payment or credit limit (PAID)
PAID status automatically triggers a FieldWorkJob

items.name: Field Work Planning & Implementation Lifecycle
items.description: Lifecycle of fieldwork from paid assignment to deployment and reconciliation.
steps: New job created from paid sizing proposal (Pending Assignment)
Technical Manager assigns Technical Team Leader (TTL)
TTL accepts job and drafts deployment plan (workers, tools, per-diem, fuel)
TTL submits plan to Technical Manager (SUBMITTED_TM)
TM reviews and forwards to GM (CHECKED_TM)
GM approves structural cost (APPROVED_GM)
Finance verifies payouts and marks deployment (DEPLOYED)
TTL submits completion report and reconciles tools (RETURNED/COMPLETED)

items.name: General Request Routing (HierarchyRequest)
items.description: Approval flow for generic claims (travel per-diems, marketing advances, restock approvals).
steps: User submits general request
Technical Manager approves request
General Manager approves request
If amount > 0, Finance Admin reviews and pays
General Manager sign-off after finance payment
Request status updated to APPROVED/PAID
